desc:
💥 DESTROY A TANK 💥
Pick your tank, roll out and blow up the enemy!

🪖 NEW: CLANS – Team up with up to 25 players. Weekly rewards: dog tags, spins, new tanks and clan camos. Send tanks and dog tags to your clan!
🔧 WORKSHOP – Upgrade your tank: armour, bigger guns, rockets and radar
🛡️ 28 TANKS – Light to super heavy, tank destroyers and modern tanks: Tiger, Sherman, Abrams, K2, Maus, Object 279 and more
🗺️ 10 MAPS – NEW: The Big Gun, Ship Graveyard, Rocket Base and The Great Wall, plus 6 more
🎯 3 MODES – Conquest, Hold the Fort and Team Deathmatch, plus ABNORMAL rounds with 2x speed, damage or reload
🎡 WIN TANKS – The best player each round spins the wheel: Rare, Epic, Legendary, Ultra and Classified prizes!
🎖️ DOG TAGS – Earn them in battle. Buy tanks, camo and nose art
🏆 TOP 1000 – Climb the all-time kills board. The top 100 get free spins every day!
🛸 Watch out for the UFO tripod!
📱🎮💻 Play on phone, console and PC

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for new tanks and updates!
